summary:
Phase 2.1 — Official Campaign Blocker Resolution & Real Firestore Security Rules Verification Report:
1. Two-Stage Initialization Architecture: Campaign created in 'initializing' state with atomic 10-shard batch, followed by validated activation transition evaluating all 10 shards (0 through 9).
2. Access-Call Limits Analysis: Exactly 10 calls during activation transition (10 of 10 max), 2 calls per shard create, 0-2 calls on parent create, and 3-1-2 calls on contribution transaction.
3. Official Campaign Shard 9 Omission RESOLVED: All 10 shards (including shard 9) are verified for both personal and official campaigns.
4. Java Runtime & Emulator Enabled: OpenJDK 21 headless installed, @firebase/rules-unit-testing installed, firebase.json configured.
5. Real Emulator Test Suite Execution: 30 / 30 tests PASSED in the live local Cloud Firestore Emulator with 0 failures.
6. Zero Production Deployment: No deployment occurred, no remote secrets or production databases modified.
